news: Those who've doubted us have been proven wrong.
Security operations conducted by WFC have suppressed the violence plaguing parts of our city.
With illicit wearable weaponry now off the streets,
we assure you that the city is a better place—
roof: I told you to take that off on the job.
The world should know who we are.
The world is not ready for us. And neither are we.
Before we are, it's best to stay invisible.
Hiding. Waiting. Lying low. I'm sick of it all. This is not what you promised, Maya.
That, Kai, is why you need more time. And we both know I'm not the only one who thinks this way.
roofPaid: A wad of cash for two rings made by a kid.
Minimal force, and only on my mark. Are we clear?
roofRobbed: Two rings. Didn't cost us a thing.
I told you to pay her. The cash was the point.
Minimal force, and only on my mark. Are we clear?
roofStiffed: She took the cash. And kept the rings.
roofFought: Six of them. She put six of them on the ground.
You sent a crew after a kid?
I wanted to see what she could do.
Now you have. Next time, pay her.
roofScout: She looked right at me, you know. Earlier.
trkPlanted: She's… on a delivery truck. Doing laps.
voicemail: Hey Robin. I'm still waiting on your decision on a summer internship.
I understand why you might be inclined to take your time, considering, for the lack of a better word, the cushion your family background provides—
knock: Nobody's lost me before, you know.
I had to ask around. Open up, Robin.
apt1: Relax, Robin. I just want to talk.
Oh. Very spunky. I like you already.
apt2Mom: Considering who your mother is, a coveted internship at the WFC will definitely shut that annoying counselor up.
But you don't need that, do you?
apt2: A coveted internship would definitely shut that annoying counselor up.
But you don't need that, do you?
apt3: I'm a fan of your work. Actually, I've got one of your toys myself.
Your help. But perhaps you should ask yourself that question as well.
What do you want to do with your life, Robin? Sit behind a desk your mother picked out for you? Or take a shot at changing the world?
Didn't know chances like that would turn up unannounced in the middle of the night. Not interested, no thanks.
I would take some time to consider if I were you.
Okay, first, you're not me. Second, you and me, we're very different. I don't break into other people's home and threaten them.
You're right, Robin. I'm not you. But I know the situation you're in.
apt4Mom: Mommy wouldn't be too happy if she found out what you were up to earlier, am I right?
apt4: Somebody out there would pay a lot for the name behind YU. Am I right?
apt5: We're not that different, Robin. Making quick cash sure feels good, but there is so much happening in the shadows of our city, beyond what WFC can control.
Whether you've realized or not, your talent has led you on a dangerous path alone, and I'm here to offer you the map.
How do I know you're not the danger?
Come with me and I'll show you.
You'll spare me the unpleasant part of this job, and believe me, you don't want to go there.
You come here, uninvited, dropping threats veiled as compliments, and you think that's going to convince me?
There are rules that I have to follow.
Not all of us are blessed with choice.
Well, I make my own rules.
hands: Hands where I can see them.
after2: I'll wait till she comes back.
That little punk. She'll pay for this.
Stop. This wouldn't have happened if you listened to me. Go. You're done here.
after3: She got away because I listened to you. I should've just nabbed her in that alley. I'm done with all this no violence bull crap.
What are you gonna do? Go back to working alone? Or beg your father to take you back in?
chair3: Told you. Should've just nabbed her in that alley. I'm done with all this no violence bull crap.
What are you gonna do? Go back to working alone? Or beg your father to take you back in?
chairLeave: Stay put, Robin. I'll be right back.
chairCall: (on the stairs) …no. She's thinking about it.
(on the stairs) Give her a minute.
fightIn7: I really hate when people make me do things twice.
fightCombo: Okay, there's a few more of you than I expected.
fightMore: Do you guys have, like, a group chat or something?
fightText: 📱 You just cost us a lot of money.
raidIn3: THERE! DROP THE BAG! GET ON THE GROUND!
raidGun: SUSPECT IS ON THE ROOFTOPS. ALL UNITS, SECTOR 9.
raidHands: HANDS WHERE I CAN SEE THEM!
raidPass: Yeah, I'm gonna pass on that.
momRing: Oh, you've gotta be kidding me.
momCall1: Hey, Robin. I'm still at work. I think I'm going to be later than usual tonight.
You okay? You sound out of breath.
momCall2: Alright. Don't stay up too late.
pa: Robin, please report to Room 120. Robin, Room 120.
caught2: That's not really how attendance works.
frustrate: The fact that I'm standing here?
The fact that I know you could have finished this in an hour.
help: Come on. I need your help.
psi: This is what I've been working on.
Honestly? We don't completely understand it yet.
We've managed to hold a tiny field. It's unstable. But it's real.
psi2: The problem is the prototype. Every time we expose it to the field, it malfunctions.
spike: The energy output spikes whenever the actuator—
fighting: You're telling it to maintain a constant output while the Psi field is fluctuating.
keepYou: That's why I keep you around.
most: You know, most people wait until I finish explaining the problem.
worried: That's exactly what I'm worried about.
brilliant: You're brilliant, Robin. You know that, right?
No. I don't think you have.
intuition: You have the kind of intuition that could take you somewhere extraordinary.
but: But you're late. You're missing assignments. You're exhausted. You're somewhere else half the time.
disappear: I don't care about one late assignment. I care that you're starting to disappear.
best: You could be one of the best roboticists I've ever taught.
mom: Your mom knows how talented you are.
She'd be proud to see what you're capable of.
canonHi: You said "trust me." That's never good.
canonIn: Harbor Lane Station. Closed since before we were born.
walkA: So what's the thing your teacher has you working on?
It kept fighting itself. The field it sits in moves, and it wasn't moving with it.
walkB: You talk about machines like they're people.
I'll take that as a compliment.
canonSwitch: The barrier's tied to the old signal switch.
canonGizmo: Okay. I want to show you something. Don't laugh.
I built it out of a dead phone and a radio. It picks something up down here.
I don't know. It just hums. Only in the tunnels.
canonPsi: It's like the field in the lab.
My teacher keeps Psi energy in a containment rig. A few centimetres of it.
It's not supposed to be loose down here.
Can you make it read it properly?
canonTuned: You just tuned something you've never seen before.
It's the same wave as the lab. You just have to match it.
I built it. You're the one who understands it.
canonBoost: Two and a half metres up.
And then what? I live down here now?
And then I pull you up.
canonDoor: Since when does the WFC own a dead station?
Since when does the WFC ask?
meetMaya: Two kids in a dead station. Cute.
meetKai: So why are you in it?
Same reason as everybody down here. Nobody looks.
meetWfc: The WFC sealed this station and forgot about it. That's what they do.
Yeah. Nobody down here likes the WFC.
meetYu: They're scared of one girl in a pair of shoes. YU.
What's that in your pocket? It's singing.
mayaIn: You don't fight like a kid.
I took a lot of self-defence classes.
mayaGlitch: What is that? Turn it off.
robinGo: Get out of here, Robin. Get out. Go. GO.
newsLive: We are live over Harbor Lane, where something — we don't know what — has come up out of the ground.
WFC are asking everyone to stay indoors.
And we're now hearing it may be chasing someone.
wfcFreeze: FREEZE! WFC! Hands where we can see them!
It's YU. That thing followed HER.
wfcCanon: A boy went into Harbor Lane Station this afternoon and never came out. Canon Cortez. Where is he?
It took him! That thing took him, I tried to—
It chased her across half the city and never laid a hand on her.
She's with it. Take her DOWN!
hideCry: Pick up. Pick up, pick up, please.
hideCry2: Canon, it's me. Please. Just... tell me you're okay.
I'm so sorry. I'm gonna get you back. I promise.
aptPhone: It's me. I'm at the residence.
Then widen it. Every unit we have.
reveal2: Taken out of Harbor Lane Station this afternoon, in front of half the city.
Don't look at me like that. You were seen near that station today.
Something tore its way up out of the ground. And YU was standing right next to it.
reveal3: That boy is gone because of her. YU, and whatever she dragged up out of the dark.
reveal4: As of an hour ago, every officer in this city is hunting her. For the abduction, and possible murder, of Canon Cortez.
And when I find her, Robin...
momPhone2: Okay. I need you home before dinner.
